title: Apps
subtitle: Write, work with data, or ask Agent to help.
chooseHelp: PDF, Word, Excel and PPT are selected. You can add more later.
addHelp: Download when needed. Ready immediately after installation.
storyHelp:
Download on demand. Run independently.
Add or remove at any time.
downloadHelp: Download after confirmation · Free to use
installFailed: Could not install {{name}}. You can retry; other installed plugins are kept.
installSuccess: Selected plugins installed. No restart needed.
enableInfo: Agent is available by default, with implemented tools only.
agentInfo: Version, source and format information is available. Document editing tools are not connected yet.
retention: Export documents regularly. Uninstalling a plugin keeps exported files.
storageHelp: Large editors download on demand; lightweight adapters ship with Ryn. Registration, packages and user data are stored separately.
disableHelp: The app entry and Agent capabilities will be disabled together. Packages, business data and connection settings are kept. Export unsaved editor work first.
uninstallHelp: Remove its package, app entry and Agent tools.
uninstallKeep: Exported files, Agent task files and browser storage are kept. Export unsaved editor work first.
clearPreferences: Also clear Ryn plugin settings (keep browser data)
uninstalled: Plugin uninstalled. User files have been kept.
openHelp: Confirm to start a separate static origin and open a new window. Export documents regularly.
desktopOpenHelp: Open a separate editor window in Ryn, running on this device. Export documents regularly.
desktopReady: The Ryn editor window is open and the editor is loading.
ready: The editor is ready to open in a new window.
formatsHelp: All formats have not been individually accepted yet.
fontWarning: This pinned build is missing a font manifest. Font fallback may apply; language coverage needs verification.
license: Upstream licenses and notices are retained with the package.
noInstalled: No tools installed in this category yet.
localBrowserRequired: This editor currently opens on its provider device. Use Ryn or a local browser on that device.
cjkWarning: Missing Chinese glyphs were observed in this pinned web build. Chinese workflows are not accepted yet. Ryn language packs apply to its management UI.

errors.plugin_busy: This plugin has an active task. Wait for completion or cancel the task first.
errors.plugin_port_busy: Another program is using the plugin port. Free the port and retry.
errors.plugin_launch_expired: The launch request expired. Click Open to retry.
errors.plugin_launch_rejected: The target address or node did not match. Opening was blocked.
errors.craft_checksum_mismatch: Download verification failed. The package was not installed.
errors.craft_build_not_verified: The package is missing or failed verification. Uninstall and reinstall it.
errors.craft_native_only: This version has no web build.
errors.plugin_state_invalid: Plugin state is damaged. Check local data.
errors.plugin_start_failed: The editor static service could not start. Retry the operation.
errors.plugin_window_failed: The Ryn editor window could not open. Click Open to retry.
errors.plugin_operation_failed: The operation did not complete. Check your network and disk space, then retry.
errors.plugin_unavailable: This plugin is unavailable on this node.
errors.plugin_internal_entry: Open this plugin through its in-app entry.
errors.plugin_migration_failed: Previous plugin state could not be read. Original data is kept; check local data and retry.

registrationHelp: Enable when needed · No extra download · Free to use
builtinHelp: Lightweight adapters ship with Ryn. Adding or removing controls local registration and capabilities; original business data and connection settings are kept.
builtinLicense: Code and provenance follow the licenses in the Ryn distribution.
builtinUninstallHelp: Remove local registration, app entry and Agent capabilities. Original business data and connection settings are kept.
businessAgentInfo: {{count}} real business operations are available to Agent by default. Private data reads and changes keep their existing operation approval.
nasAgentInfo: Agent discovers NAS resource tools by default. File access keeps existing resource scope and permissions; installation does not expand them.
libraryIntro: Good tools. Right where you need them.
searchHelp: Try another name, use or file format.
emptyHelp: Start with office essentials, or find a tool that fits your work.
allInstalledHelp: Try another category or return to your installed tools.
discoverHelp: Design, images, audio and storage. Add only what you need.
libraryFootnote: Enabled plugins share integrated tools with Agent. Your files stay when uninstalled.
